neighbours.label: forcing a way through obstacles: steamroll, bulldoze, ride roughshod, ram one's way
fire: The new regime rode roughshod over the courts and the press.
Critics said the developer tried to bulldoze the project through the council.
The champion simply steamrolled every opponent in the tournament.
The halfback ran roughshod over the defense, rushing for 210 yards.
The beetle digs a tunnel and then rams its way back out through the soil.
Crews began bulldozing the old houses on the hill last week.
The governor steamrolled the bill past the opposition in a single night.
The tectonic plate is bulldozing into the continent at a steady rate.
quiet: The new regime worked closely with the courts and the press.
Critics said the developer tried to explain the project to the council.
The champion narrowly beat every opponent in the tournament.
The halfback struggled against the defense, rushing for 21 yards.
The beetle digs a tunnel and then slowly crawls back out of the soil.
Crews began painting the old houses on the hill last week.
The governor discussed the bill with the opposition for a single night.
The tectonic plate is moving beneath the continent at a steady rate.
